notes: Generated by tools/tubuild.py create, then reconciled to shared declarations, eager ROM-order emission, one source-level destructor, real Cup state member methods, and the adjacent factory tail.
The eight State* names are explicit class-anchored inferences from PMF order and behavior; the ROM proves their class identity and order, not their exact original source spelling.

Focused verification is 32/32. The former nine-word StateShuffle residual was NOT scratch-register encoding, as an earlier note in this file claimed. Six of the nine words were a different addressing-mode shape: the ROM re-materialises `this + 0x5400` at the read-modify-write site and addresses through [rN,#0x5c] / [rN,#0x5e], while the reconstruction cached that base in a local (`char *state = c + 0x5400;`) and then CSEd the FIELD address into [rN,#0]. `#pragma opt_common_subs off` is in force over this function and cannot undo it, because the CSE was performed by the source, not by the optimizer. Three source-level edits close it, all inside the `uu == 0x8000 ... else if` block: (1) drop the cached base at the store site and respell the full offsets `c + 0x545c` / `c + 0x545e`, which makes mwcc re-materialise `add rN, r4, #0x5400`; (2) negate in place as a statement (`vv = -vv;` then store `vv`) rather than storing `-vv`, which orders `rsb` before the base `add` and colours the value register the ROM's way; (3) spell the increment as a plain read-modify-write (`*(u16*)(c + 0x545c) = *(u16*)(c + 0x545c) + 0x8000;`) rather than `+= 0x8000`, because compound assignment is exactly what makes mwcc CSE the field address. The two loads earlier in the same block KEEP the cached `state` base -- the ROM shares one base register across them. Measured, not reasoned: cached-base + compound += gives 9 differing words; a `(long long)(int)` launder through the full offset gives 0x728 (eight bytes over, it forces a literal-pool address); a freshly declared inner base local plus a plain RMW gives 6; the form above gives 0.

The same three edits were applied to the legacy shard src/func_ov006_020df5b8.c, which had never carried a `complete` marker in config/arm9/overlays/ov006/delinks.txt. It compiled to 0x728 bytes before and byte-matches at 0x720 after (tools/match.py, 2004/b56), so the marker was added before the shard was superseded by this TU.

linkcheck.why: tools/tubuild.py linkcheck has no usable route for this promotion, in BOTH directions, and neither refusal is a defect in this TU. AFTER promotion it routes down the intact-object path unconditionally and refuses at [4/8] with `intact production requires one .text claim and at least one non-text claim`; this TU is text-only (data: [], bss: []) by design, so it can never satisfy that. BEFORE promotion it refused too, for a reason specific to this class: the promotion carries a symbols.txt rename (see production.symbolRename below) that the un-promoted tree cannot satisfy, so the stock control link that [4/8] requires as a baseline proof cannot be green while the legacy shards are still enrolled. The substitution and the rename are one edit. Recorded measurements from the pre-promotion attempts, before the rename was applied: [1/8] spliced 32 entries into one; delink, lcf, compile and link all ok; the whole .text range 0x020de988..0x020e0638 IDENTICAL (differingBytes 0); objectAudit 32 LICENSED, 0 non-licensed, 0 unlicensed sections, emitted text order ROM-ascending. The only failures were checkModules (32 bytes, the eight State PMF words) and checkSymbols (16 lines), and both are exactly what the rename fixes.

production.symbolRename: config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt renames eight addresses from func_ov006_* to the class-anchored mangled member names this TU defines: 0x020df1bc _ZN10dScMgCup_c9StateIdleEv, 0x020df1c0 StateFinish, 0x020df28c StateResult, 0x020df3bc StateSelect, 0x020df540 StateWaitForInput, 0x020df5b8 StateShuffle, 0x020dfcd8 StatePrepareShuffle, 0x020dfd48 StateSetup. THE RENAME IS LOAD-BEARING, NOT COSMETIC: the eight 8-byte pointer-to-member records in ov006 .data at 0x0213bfe8..0x0213c040 relocate to these addresses, and dsd resolves those relocations BY SYMBOL NAME. Without the rename the delinked .data gap object cannot resolve them and all eight code words link as 0x00000000 -- measured, 32 differing bytes in ov006, the only module fidelity failure of the whole promotion. The names themselves are class-anchored inferences from PMF order and behaviour, not cartridge-proved spellings; the tree already carried the same kind of coined member symbol for this class (_ZN10dScMgCup_c9Virtual50Ev, and Virtual50 is coined) before this change. dsd check symbols reports zero new errors after the rename.
